issues.description: install --dry-run still triggers full download via prepare_linked_requirements_more
issues.detail: The new install.py block unconditionally calls preparer.prepare_linked_requirements_more before the dry-run early return at line ~414's SUCCESS path. If the dry-run branch returns before this call, fine; but if placed after, dry-run will still download. Verify the call sits below the dry_run SUCCESS return, otherwise the stated goal of the PR is not achieved.

issues.description: req.prepared / needs_more_preparation flags no longer reset after preparation
issues.detail: The resolver previously set req.prepared = True and req.needs_more_preparation = False after the bulk prepare. That block was removed entirely, but the new prepare_linked_requirements_more calls in install/download/wheel commands don't appear to set these flags. Downstream code branching on req.prepared or needs_more_preparation may now misbehave (re-preparation, skipped steps).

issues.description: download_info constructed from req.source_dir which may be None in dry-run/metadata-only path
issues.detail: In prepare.py, after metadata-only fetch, direct_url_from_link(req.link, req.source_dir) is invoked. In the metadata-only path no source_dir is unpacked, so source_dir is typically None. direct_url_from_link may accept None, but the resulting DirectUrl will lack subdirectory info or behave inconsistently versus the post-download path. Confirm parity with the full-download download_info.

issues.description: set_dist caches metadata-only distribution that later shadows fully-prepared dist
issues.detail: get_dist now returns self._distribution first, before checking metadata_directory or local_file_path. After a metadata-only fetch sets _distribution, a subsequent prepare_linked_requirements_more that fully downloads and unpacks the wheel will NOT update _distribution. Consumers calling get_dist post-install will see the metadata-only BaseDistribution rather than the real installed dist, risking missing files/RECORD info.

issues.description: Newsfragment wording omits --report and pip download behavior
issues.detail: news/12603.feature.rst mentions only pip lock and pip install --dry-run, but the diff also affects pip download, pip wheel, and --report. Users reading the changelog won't learn that pip download/wheel ordering changed (prepare_more now runs before the iteration loop). Consider clarifying scope or noting the no-op behavioral reordering.

issues.description: No regression test included for the dry-run no-download claim
issues.detail: The PR closes #12603 with a behavioral guarantee (no full wheel download under --dry-run with PEP-658 metadata), but no functional test asserts that the network/cache never receives the wheel bytes in that path. Without a test, future refactors can silently regress this. A test using a fake index serving PEP-658 metadata would lock the behavior.

review.summary: The PR achieves its goal by moving the "more preparation" step out of the resolver and into the commands that actually need downloads, plus caching the metadata-only distribution on InstallRequirement. The main concerns are: (1) the resolver no longer resets req.prepared / needs_more_preparation flags, which downstream code may rely on; (2) get_dist now prefers the cached metadata-only dist even after a real download, which could shadow the fully-prepared distribution; (3) download_info is constructed from possibly-None source_dir in the metadata-only branch. A regression test for the no-download dry-run behavior would also harden the fix.
